subject: Ad free
author: ZombieTron
body:
Personally I want to keep it Ad free, but it does cost money to run the site. We have already had a super kind donation, we have a donate button on the left hand menu (hint hint) and we may start other schemes to raise the money to cover our running costs, like merchandise?? I don't think we could ever wangle free Paradise copies for every member tho!!

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Congradulations
author: SUFFUR
body:
Now when do we get advertizing, lol? So we don't have to buy Paradise, we get given them free as we are members of the site, lol. Truth be told will you sell out to the banners and other advertising gimicks or keep it clean, or gain a sponsor?

No, its great news, were almost up to the amount of views that randy dog had, lol!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
